title: Editor E1, slice 2: the eleven blocks drawn by ContentBlockView join the contract
detail: Adopts callout, text, links, image, features, gallery, quote, embed, recording, button and contactForm into lib/entity-blocks/contract/. Content and inspector fields come from the registry's own field list through lib/entity-blocks/contract/from-fields.ts (one source, so they cannot name different keys); each block has one component under components/entity-blocks/blocks/ that draws through ContentBlockView. Nothing a visitor or editor sees changes. check:blocks now holds 13 of 41. Left on PROG-E1: the design and email-card blocks, the 18 data blocks, and the binding layer.

verify.note: Fails when an adopted block stops holding the contract. 2026-10-20: the eleven content blocks are among the adopted set.
